newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Ex-Zimbabwe minister in court over hospital death.
newsitem.headline: Ex-Zimbabwe minister in court over hospital death.

text.p: A former Zimbabwe health minister is on trial charged with culpable homicide over the death of a 16-month-old baby after surgery he conducted, local media reported on Tuesday.
Felix Muchemwa is alleged to have inadvertedly sutured part of the child's intestines to the interior abdominal wall during surgery in February 1996.

Muchemwa -- a medical doctor who was minister of health in President Robert Mugabe's government in the 1980s and is now employed by a state hospital -- denied the charge when he appeared before a Harare magistrate on Monday. The trial is continuing.
